purpose: Pilot-scoped, NON-OPERATIONAL claim records for Pilot 01. Kept OUT of the canonical claim registries because per-claim operational activation is unresolved (claim_activation_policy.json). Individually reviewed; none is operational, none is published.

claims.statement_intended: Under an applicable official trade nomenclature, commodity code X represents the exact official sulfur commodity description Z.
claims.reason: The Office des Changes 2024 annual report states NO HS/nomenclature code for sulfur; it uses the product label 'Soufres bruts et non raffinés'. No authoritative classification source (WCO/ADII) was fetched in this pilot. Additionally the label is a crude/unrefined SUBSET of the general 'sulfur' concept, so even a label-to-concept mapping is only partial. Not asserted from model memory (inadmissible AI summary).

claims.statement: Morocco recorded imports of the product 'Soufres bruts et non raffinés' during calendar year 2024 (official Office des Changes statistics).
claims.scope_guard: Existence of official recorded import activity only. NOT 'Morocco depends on sulfur imports', NOT 'major importer', NOT 'needs sulfur for phosphates'.

claims.statement: Official recorded 2024 TOTAL import VALUE of 'Soufres bruts et non raffinés' (reporter Morocco, flow imports, partner Monde, table T1-10) = 9108 MDH (source literal '9.108'; dot = thousands separator); average unit price = 1099 DH/T (G1-5, source literal '1.099'). Absolute quantity in tonnes is NOT stated by the source (only a +27,4% quantity change).
claims.outcome: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (total value + unit price supported; tonnage BLOCKED)
claims.scope_guard: TOTAL imports (T1-10) only. The ATPA-with-payment figure (9102 MDH, T3-4) and the Asia-origin figure (8737 MDH, T4-9) are DIFFERENT SCOPES, not variants of the total, and must never substitute for it. Value/price exactly as printed and normalized (thousands separators). Tonnage NOT derived from value/price. No industrial-demand inference.
